title: approvals: the record lock reads cannot say whether a row is held by its own approval or by its master's, so a list cannot tell which locked rows may still be deleted
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzeiHatzB4rRx1t4Php
Ruled: 7148480184 · letter A · 2026-11-25T00:22Z

Filing gate: ② a decision only the maintainer can make (a fleet `Feature`: it revises ruled contract text and widens a published return type) · Source: fleet (the shape question of #37041, split out on seat repo:objectstack#3's routing call; the parity fix lands alone in PR #37145). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

After PR #37145 (#37041), both approval lock reads answer `{ locked: true }` for a record held by its own locking approval **and** for a master-detail line whose master is held. They do not say which. The two differ on delete:

- A record held by its own approval may be deleted; the delete cancels the request (#13568).
- A line of a held master refuses insert, update **and** delete: `bindDetailRowLockHook` in `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/lifecycle-hooks.ts`.

PR #37128 (#36911, seat 4) makes the grid row menu read the batch door: a locked row offers no Edit and keeps Delete. On a master-held line that Delete is refused `RECORD_LOCKED`. Seat 4's consumer constraint: #37041 comment 7145422785.

## Options (measured on PR #37145's branch, head 9b5bdcd8; details in its body)

- **A — a lock-kind field on both lock doors**, e.g. `heldBy: 'record' | 'master'` (master wins when both hold), on `IApprovalService.getRecordLock`, `getRecordLocks` and both REST doors (`packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts`), and the grid hides Delete on `heldBy: 'master'`. Revises the #25934 ruling A text carried in the `getRecordLock` docblock (`packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts`): "What is answered: `locked` only." Widens a published return type ⇒ `Clause-②: yes`. Disclosure reading: a caller who can write the line already learns the kind from the `RECORD_LOCKED` sentence (`record_locked` names the line, `record_locked_untitled` names the master's label); a read-only line reader who is served no request learns one new bit; no request content either way.
- **B — the grid alone hides Delete on every locked row of an object that has a `master_detail` field.** No contract change. Also hides Delete on a self-held line under an unheld master, which the server accepts, and copies the server's delete rule into the client. Collides with PR #37128's files (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridActionsColumn.tsx`, `ObjectGrid.tsx`): starts only after it merges.
- **Keep** — no change. After #37145 the grid offers Delete on master-held lines and the server refuses it with the existing toast (#36885); before #37145 it offered Edit and Delete and refused both.

Dev and wf-B recommendation: A (the server's own judgement is the single source; no client copy of a server rule). The seat takes the question to the maintainer and posts the ruling here.

## Done when (if A is ruled)

- Both lock doors answer `{ locked, heldBy }` for a locked row and the docblocks, route doc and REST comment say so; `null` keeps meaning unreadable-or-missing, indistinguishable.
- Pins: single/batch parity of `heldBy` for a record held itself, a line of a held master, a self-held line under a held master, an unheld record.
- The grid row menu hides Delete on `heldBy: 'master'` (after #37128 has merged), with a pin.

Business reason: anyone working the lines of an expense report or order under approval in a list page is offered a Delete the server then refuses; the batch lock door exists so a list can know first.
Reader: the seat that takes area:workflow p2 (repo:objectstack#3, zone wf-B) builds the ruled option.
Grading: area:workflow · Feature · moderate (an offered action the server refuses; no data written wrong) · reach named (grid row menu via #37128, showcase expense lines) → p2. Triage confirms area, type, grade and domain.
Dedupe: `heldBy` → 0 relevant open (only #37041); `getRecordLock` → #37041, #36911, #35863 open (none on this question), #26314, #35795, #26362 closed; `master-held line delete` → #37041, #36911 only.
